name: disposition-granted-by-secondary-detachment
note: The pick may be granted by ANY selected detachment, not only the primary: reconnaissance comes from librarius-conclave (second), so no disposition-invalid fires.

name: points-over-limit-from-wargear-costs
note: 5 Terminator Assault Squads at 10 models (340/340/380/380/380) plus a 90-point Captain = 1910 base (legal at 2000), but each squad's six storm shields (wargear_costs 5 pts each = 30/squad, +150) push the army to 2060 — over the limit. points-over-limit here is produced ONLY by charging wargear_costs over the loadout, so every port must sum them identically (issue 75). Five copies of one datasheet also exceed the strike-force unit limit of 3.

name: allied-pricing-legal-at-limit
note: Four Officio Assassinorum units in a Blood Angels host army price at their Imperium allied_points cost (125 + 110 + 100 + 85 = 420; native 395) beside 580 of Blood Angels units: exactly 1000 at incursion. Pins that host-army pricing selects the allied table for a foreign unit whose host_faction keyword the army's faction carries.

name: allied-pricing-points-over-limit
note: Swapping the Chaplain (70) for a Librarian (75) totals 1005 under allied pricing vs 980 native: points-over-limit fires ONLY when the Imperium allied_points entries are applied.

name: detachment-pricing-points-over-limit
note: Native costs total 960 (legal at 1000); Pantheon of Woe's detachment_pricing raises the two C'tan Shards to 375 and 380, pushing the army to 1040. points-over-limit fires ONLY when detachment_pricing for a selected detachment replaces the native tiers.

name: legal-detachment-pricing-not-selected
note: The same list outside Pantheon of Woe prices from native points (960) and is legal.

name: ally-points-over-limit
note: Blood Legions units total 1045 (320 + 320 + 315 + 90) against the 1000 strike-force cap.

name: legal-exclusive-pool-enhancement
note: The Blood Legions pool carries no enhancement lock: Khorne Daemonkin's Blood-Forged Armour targets BLOOD LEGIONS.

name: legal-keyword-limit-detachment-override
note: Ghosts of the Webway's keyword_limit_overrides raise the Asuryani TROUPE MASTER cap from 1 to 3.

name: keyword-limit-exceeded-over-override
note: Four Troupe Masters exceed both Ghosts of the Webway's raised cap of 3 and the strike-force unit limit of 3.

name: keyword-limit-alternatives-exceeded
note: An `alternatives` cap counts distinct keywords present: Farsight and an Ethereal are two of the group's alternatives against max 1. A `units` reading (units carrying every keyword) would never fire, since no unit is both.

name: legal-keyword-limit-alternatives-repeated
note: Two Ethereals are one alternative: an `alternatives` cap does not count units, so a units-with-any reading (which would reject this list) diverges here.

name: unit-limit-exceeded
note: Three copies of one datasheet against the incursion unit limit of 2 (strike force allows 3).

name: legal-unit-limit-battleline-doubled
note: BATTLELINE doubles the strike-force unit limit from 3 to 6.

name: unit-limit-exceeded-epic-hero
note: Every EPIC HERO has a unit limit of 1. Two copies of one Graves datasheet are one alternative to the Graves keyword cap, so only the unit limit fires.

name: enhancement-limit-exceeded
note: Three Enhancements against the incursion Enhancement limit of 2 (strike force allows 4).

name: enhancement-on-epic-hero
note: 11e Select Enhancements: EPIC HERO models cannot be given Enhancements. Khârn is a World Eaters CHARACTER, so every other enhancement check passes.

name: enhancement-on-excluded-model
note: The Ogryn Bodyguard is an ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY CHARACTER (every other Enhancement check passes), but its only model is excluded_from_enhancements.
